curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with why signs matter and the three sign types, then the four-way stop order, the YIELD sign, wrong-way and one-way entry signs, the railroad sign and no left turn.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign rule; contrast cards for the four-way stop order and the tie-break.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a sign or a four-way stop and asking what to do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover no-parking, handicapped parking and emergency stopping signs, then speed limit, minimum speed and school-zone signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each parking and speed sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what each parking and speed sign allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the lane-use and turn prohibition signs, no turn on red, double right turns, keep-right, one-way and the regulatory no-passing sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each turn and lane sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which turns a sign allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach warning sign colors and shape, then the curve, side-road, bump, road-ends and soft-shoulder warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each warning; a contrast card for black-on-yellow, black-on-orange and fluorescent yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a warning and asking what lies ahead.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover narrowing roads, islands, dips and one-lane bridges, stop and yield ahead, advisory speeds, railroad ahead, low shoulders, truck and fire crossings, pavement ends, dead ends and lane ends.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each warning; contrast cards for the narrowing signs and for warnings versus the controls they announce.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a warning and asking how to respond.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the no-passing warning, low clearance, two-way traffic and merge signs, then signals, crossroads, divided highways, hills and hazard warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each warning; a contrast card for where the no-passing warning stands.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on passing, merging and road-change warnings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish with pedestrian, school and bicycle signs, sharrows, then road construction, worker and arrow-panel warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each crossing, cyclist and work-zone sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crossings, cyclists and work zones.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec08-m01..sec08-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Regulatory and warning signs (more warning, crossing and work-zone signs, confusables)

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
